study_title: Table design study: Google/DeepMind, Meta and NVIDIA

scope.prior_corpus_reuse: All 18 selected reports came from the restored cs-paper-figure paper-corpus.csv; each selected table was independently rendered and visually inspected.
scope.non_claim: This study does not claim table inspection of all 120 prior figure papers; no venue-quality or corporate house-style inference is made.

coordinate_system: Unrotated PDF points, top-left origin, x rightward and y downward; pages are 1-based.

evidence_taxonomy.measured: Nominal PDF text/vector properties, object coordinates, and explicitly documented extraction-derived layout measurements.
evidence_taxonomy.observed: Visual inspection and interpretation of table structure, semantics, emphasis, and comparability.
evidence_taxonomy.recommended: Analyst design lessons and cautions, not claimed to be author or corporate policy.

papers.title: Gemma 4 Technical Report
papers.affiliation_evidence: Page 1: Gemma Team, Google DeepMind; Google DeepMind copyright.

observations.purpose: Compact memory / deployment profile.
observations.headers_and_grouping: One model stub plus bf16, Quantized, and KV Cache columns. Model names are bold; no multilevel header.

numeric_alignment_and_precision.evidence_type: visual inspection of rendered PDF, corroborated by text extraction; source column implementation is not known
numeric_alignment_and_precision.description: Values appear centered by column. Mostly one decimal; quantized entries include two decimals, and the MoE row uses slash-separated compound values. KV entries carry an explicit plus sign. Superscripts attach quantization qualifications.

observations.uncertainty_and_missingness: No dispersion or interval. The dagger and double dagger describe quantization methods; the asterisk on one model is a separate marker, not an uncertainty symbol.
observations.emphasis_semantics: Model names are bold for scanning; numerical values have no winner ranking, no fill and no color.

rules_and_spacing.evidence_type: visual inspection; exact PDF strokes are listed separately
rules_and_spacing.description: Three horizontal rules (top, header separator, bottom); no vertical lines. Caption wraps below the narrow table.

observations.caption_notes_and_comparability: The caption states text-only weights and added int8 KV cache at 32k context and decodes two quantization markers. It prints the memory unit as “Gb”, so a reusable design should spell out an unambiguous byte/bit convention.

measurements.evidence_type: PyMuPDF PDF-object extraction, not a visual estimate
measurements.baseline_measurement_caveat: Baselines of extracted single-span numeric strings with at least two occurrences on the same rounded y; mixed-size annotations and split numeric spans can be omitted. This is an output-layout measurement, not inferred TeX row padding.
caveats: Font resources are page-level references; the visible table font summary selects only text traces inside table_bbox_pt, excluding the caption.
Recorded PDF colors are nominal 8-bit conversions and retain opacity; actual rendering may depend on color management.
All vector stroke histograms may include short value underlines; use long_horizontal_rules for structural horizontal lines.
Neither numeric alignment nor source TeX column spec is inferred from fonts alone.

lessons: A small deployment table can remain unshaded; put precision, context length and cache convention beside the measurements.
Treat compound memory entries as structured values with a defined denominator or component meaning.
cautions: Do not interpret a plus sign as an improvement; here it marks additional cache memory.
Do not copy the ambiguous Gb notation or an unexplained slash/asterisk into a new table.
